headline: Executive order sets new pay rates for certain federal government jobs.
what_it_does: This order adjusts pay rates for certain federal positions. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to set the next year's pay tables for federal workers. The title alone does not give the exact raise amounts or the specific groups covered.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may change under the new pay schedules set by the order.
Their pay rates may be adjusted, as is common in yearly pay orders of this kind.
